column3: Saori Route ・ Resolve is Essential
I am indebted to you, Kyousuke-shi...
You have given me great aid, and yet, it will all amount to nothing...
But it hasn't amounted to anything yet!
So that's how strong your will is.
Just you thinking like that makes me feel blessed.
I'm not just thinking it. I intend to do something.
Those are very promising words.
Though, my spirit is like a dying flame in the wind now..
It's the same even if you have results. There's nothing that can be done.
Haha... It is truly a vain effort.
I think no matter how much I apologize, I have to take my hat off to you.
But, I haven't really done anything...
Even so, the fact that you tried to help me remains.
It ends today. You are officially a free man.
Saori...?
...After the wedding... I will send you a letter...
A letter showing how... happy I am with him.
Then I'll rip it up and eat it before even reading!
Kyousuke-shi, that's what white goats and black goats do.
Exactly when has my friend turned into a goat?
If you still think of me as a friend, then stop making jokes that I can't laugh at.
Where do you find fun in deceiving your friend and making him worried?
I'm not deceiving you... I am trying to show you my sincerity.
You're saying you have the resolve for marriage?
If I do not have resolve, then I cannot progress as a samurai.
Wait, you are an otaku, not a samurai.
That ends today too. From now on, I'm a bride.
A very happy bride...
I don't need your fake sincerity!
Sincerity is thinking about how the other person feels, right?
If you stop being an otaku, and stop being our friends...
Do you really think you're doing it for our sake?
...My apologies.
I'm tired of hearing you apologize!
Try saying something different from time to time.
Say "I'm relying on you!" or "Please lend me a hand!" or something like that!
Please don't give up! If you give up, then it's all over!
...have heard...
Saori?
How many times have I heard you say, "Don't give up?"
...Though, it is strange. I have not gotten tired of hearing it.
...Don't apologize. You haven't done anything wrong.
I haven't done anything right, either.
Don't be so self-degrading. You're doing the best you can.
Fufu... You are always like this.
Ha... Hahaha!
W-What is it? Suddenly laughing like that...
Well, when one considers it, it is marriage! Every girl's ultimate dream.
The moment I become a bride, I will be happier than anyone!
Happier... than anyone...
Saori...
...I am truly sorry.
Why are you apologizing...? You haven't done anything wrong yet...
You have gone this far with me, not anyone else, but me...
If I think about it, I have only been relying on you.
I think it is time to repay my debt.
